questions.stem_text: One example of bad constitutive moral luck would be:

options.A: a person who donates to charity regularly.
options.C: a person who lived in Nazi Germany in 1940.
options.D: a person who drives drunk and hits a child.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - a person who donates to charity regularly.

questions.stem_text: According to Sinnott-Armstrong, the fact your government morally ought to do something

options.A: does not prove that government officials ought to promote it.
options.B: does not prove that you ought to do it.
options.C: proves that you ought not to do it.
options.D: proves that you ought to do it, too.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - does not prove that you ought to do it.

questions.stem_text: Which is one of the most fundamental themes of Japanese culture and civilization?

options.A: Karma and the cycle of rebirth govern life and death
options.B: The universe is inherently chaotic and unpredictable
options.C: God is eternal and merciful to those who offer worship
options.D: The world is inherently evil and suffering is inevitable
options.E: Life is an illusion and the material world is meaningless

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - God is eternal and merciful to those who offer worship

questions.stem_text: According to Moore, the most fundamental question in all of ethics is:
